references.text: This text also deals with vows (נֶדֶר) and freewill offerings (נְדָבָה), and gives further rules for such offerings.
Continuation of the instructions on how long meat from a vow or freewill offering may be eaten.
Refers to vow offerings (נֶדֶר) and freewill offerings (נְדָבָה) in connection with offerings to the Lord.
Mentions vow offerings and freewill gifts that were to be brought to the place the Lord chose.
Gives instructions on where vow offerings and freewill gifts were to be eaten.
Parallel instructions concerning thank offerings and the time limit for eating the sacrificial meat.
Deals with vows (נֶדֶר) and the importance of keeping what one freely promises to the Lord.
